title: Chapter 268: Zerg’S Military Strength Exceeds 100 Million
content:
Chapter 268: Zerg’S Military Strength Exceeds 100 Million

At the foot of the Endless Mountains at the junction of the Zerg sphere of influence and the Demon territories, the Zerg second sub-base was built to a certain scale and began to hatch Zerg puppies.

After these Zerg puppies hatched, they came to the ground, crossed the border area, entered the Demon sphere of influence, and began to scout and hunt.

With sufficient resources, the Zerg can form a strong army at any time, and now there is nothing to worry about.

The Zerg puppies, as pioneers, began to move out before the second sub-base of the Zerg was built.

When the Zerg puppies entered the Demon sphere of influence and encountered a small-scale Demon, they directly contacted the surrounding Zerg puppies to come and surround and kill.

When encountering a large-scale Demon group or army, the Zerg puppies are sure to win, so they summon Zerg puppies to reinforce, besiege, and eliminate the enemy.

If they think they are no match for the enemy, they will conduct tracking and reconnaissance, obtain intelligence, and find these large-scale Demon gathering places.

With this intelligence, the Zerg army can carry out cleanup operations in a planned manner, and eventually lead the main force of the Demon to fight.

This is how the Zerg fights in the direction of the Demons. Otherwise, the Zerg has no time and energy to find the main force of the Demons.

The battlefield in the direction of the Demons will take some time to brew before the war really starts.

…

Wu Qing returned to the 66th city of the public battlefield in the southern theater. The battlefield here is still being cleaned up. A large number of Zerg worker bees work day and night to sort out all the things left on the battlefield.

The Queen of Zerg has the experience of selling spoils once, and she specially asked the Goblin merchants for relevant knowledge. She can basically distinguish the value of the spoils left on the battlefield by the aliens.

For those spoils whose value cannot be distinguished, they will be gathered together first, and then the Goblins will be consulted.

For those spoils whose value can be distinguished, they will be classified and stored uniformly, and they can be traded with various forces in the local camp later.

The spoils of the alien army are valuable, especially those of the alien army. Wu Qing tasted the sweetness in the last battle.

As long as the news of the sale of these spoils of the alien army is released, they will definitely be quickly snapped up.

All the ruins of buildings and useless things on the battlefield were transported to the underground Zerg mother nest by the Zerg worker bees and converted into energy resources.

After such meticulous cleaning by the Zerg worker bees, the battlefield area of the 66th City and its surroundings gradually became clean.

The day has just begun, and the various forces that have received the news of the Zerg's victory have not reacted so quickly. Wu Qing came over and continued to implement the Zerg's combat plan on the public battlefield.

After a night of hatching, the Zerg puppies that have spread throughout the 66th City Lord's protection area began to rush out and rushed to the wilderness outside.

Except for a small number of Zerg puppies that went forward to scout the direction of the aliens' sphere of influence, most of the Zerg puppies went back. Their main task was to clear the aliens' troops within the sphere of influence of the local camp.

The main enemy of the Zerg puppies is the goblins of the aliens. They have to use their absolute strength advantage to clear the entire sphere of influence of the local camp.

Goblins are good at escaping, burrowing, and lurking, which seems a bit childish in front of Zerg puppies. Zerg puppies are experts in this area.

As long as there are enough Zerg puppies, it is not difficult to quickly clear the goblins in the sphere of influence of the local camp.

This can be regarded as solving a major problem for the local camp. Without these goblins, the intelligence control ability of the aliens on the sphere of influence of the local camp will be greatly weakened.

The army of the local camp will not have to guard against the annoying goblins when marching outside.

Even if the alien race still has a large number of goblins, it is impossible to put them into the sphere of influence of the local camp, because the Zerg puppies will take the initiative to attack and enter the sphere of influence of the alien race, turning the offensive and defensive situation upside down.

Cooperating with the Zerg puppies, there are also a large number of Zerg hosts.

Zerg hosts fly high in the sky, providing accurate real-time intelligence for the Zerg puppies and drawing a detailed world map of the Zerg.

When the Zerg host flew out of the range of the 66th city, it found a lot of goblins. These ubiquitous and pervasive goblins finally met their nemesis.

The Zerg puppies flew up. With a one-star combat power, the Zerg puppies can fight ten goblins alone. The combat power is completely not at the same level.

A simple charge by the Zerg puppies caused a large number of goblins to fall down, and they kept turning into light and disappearing, scaring the goblins to flee.

Goblins are small in size, run fast, and scatter around. It is difficult for ordinary armies to encircle and suppress them.

But the Zerg puppies are very good at bullying such weak ones. The Zerg puppies can chase goblins to the ends of the earth. Even if the goblins burrow into the narrow cracks deep underground, they can't escape the pursuit of the Zerg puppies that can burrow into the ground.

Zerg puppies can get their money back by killing a goblin, and they can also earn some gas resources. They are not afraid of losses and waste of troops at all.

Tens of millions of Zerg puppies scattered and gradually disappeared in the vast public battlefield. They are better at hiding and lurking. Some observers who are interested find it difficult to track their whereabouts.

There are Zerg hosts in the air with stealth and powerful detection and perception capabilities, which can provide the most comprehensive and detailed real-time intelligence to find the hiding places of goblins.

The perfect combination of Zerg puppies and Zerg hosts makes the goblins of the alien race extinct wherever they pass.

The first Zerg sub-base under the 66th city has been excavated under the mountain. The underground space has become very huge. At a glance, it is full of neatly arranged Zerg nests, interspersed with a small number of Zerg defense buildings.

Zerg puppies are hatched here continuously, and through the underground passages that extend in all directions, they secretly enter the ground and join the army to clear the goblins.

The public battlefield in the southern theater is also a resource-rich place. There are many mineral resources underground. Expanding the Zerg base and mining resources are both possible, which can provide a large amount of energy resources for the system.

This is expected to become the second Zerg energy resource mining site.

The first Zerg energy resource mining site is in the territory of the underground world, where the entire Zerg territory is mining resources. It is precisely because of the resource supply of the underground world that the Zerg can hatch Zerg puppies without scruples.

The continuous exploitation of the Zerg, coupled with the continuous hunting of the Zerg puppies on multiple battlefields, has rapidly pushed the number of Zerg puppies to the scale of 100 million.

…

The 66th city occupied by the Zerg finally welcomed the first visiting team, which was a goblin airship.

The huge goblin airship, flying at high speed, came from the direction of the main city and quickly landed on an open space outside the 66th city.

It was the first time that Wu Qing saw the real goblin airship. The appearance was similar to the airship he knew. It was a behemoth with a length of more than 100 meters. The outermost layer of the airship was covered by a layer of faint energy shield.

This goblin airship is the most important aerial creation of the goblin tribe. It undertakes various tasks such as air combat and air transportation. It is one of the pinnacle works of the goblin tribe.

There are many types of goblin airships, each of which undertakes different tasks. The goblin airship that Wu Qing saw should be a relatively special comprehensive airship that can perform tasks alone and takes into account the dual capabilities of combat and transportation.

When the goblin tribe came, Wu Qing's Zerg clone came out to greet them in person.

The person who came was Gong Yi, who was in charge of Zerg-related matters in the public battlefield of the Goblin Clan in the southern war zone. When he met Wu Qing again this time, his words and attitude were a little more respectful.

This is the change of identity and status brought by strength.

The 66th City is now a ruin, with nowhere to go. Wu Qing will not let outsiders enter the underground Zerg base. A transport host that Wu Qing transferred put some things on the open space next to it as a reception place.

"The battlefield has not been cleaned up yet, so everything can only be kept simple!"

Wu Qing smiled and explained to Gong Yi.

"My Lord is polite!"

Gong Yi certainly didn't dare to have any opinions.

After a round of greetings, Gong Yi talked about business.

"My Lord, I came here this time to congratulate the nobles on behalf of my clan!"

"Congratulations to the nobles for winning the war with the aliens!"

"My clan has prepared a gift, please don't refuse!"

Gong Yi said, and handed Wu Qing a gift list politely.

Wu Qing took it with a smile and said, "Thank you for the noble's generous gift!", then slowly opened the gift list and looked at it.

The first item in it was the luck beads, and there were quite a few of them. The others were some information, books, strange creations of the goblins, and some ceremonial valuables.

The gifts prepared by the goblins, except for the ceremonial items, were all prepared according to Wu Qing's preferences, and Wu Qing felt very satisfied after seeing them.

Wu Qing also wanted to have a good relationship with the goblins, so his attitude was very friendly, one side was respectful and the other side was easy-going. The atmosphere of communication between Wu Qing and Gong Yi was very harmonious.

Wu Qing was not stingy either. He arranged for the underground Zerg base to produce a batch of Zerg energy coins, and selected a batch of valuable spoils left by the alien race, and had them sent over to Gong Yi as a return gift.

Gong Yi happily accepted it.

"My Lord, the nobles have built a space transmission channel in this city. Do you intend to stay here for a long time? If the nobles intend to use this place as a base for development, our tribe will fully support it!"

The space transmission channel is something of extremely high strategic value and cannot be built casually. The goblins are already aware of the Zerg's plan. Gong Yi asked this question just to make the final confirmation.

"Yes, our tribe is ready to use this as a base to compete with the alien race!"

"Our tribe's chamber of commerce will soon have a batch of materials delivered, all of which are some city construction personnel and materials to assist the nobles in rebuilding this city!"

"..."

After Wu Qing gave a definite reply, Gong Yi told Wu Qing about the idea that the goblins were ready to provide free assistance to the Zerg to rebuild the 66th city.
